name: Move Microsoft SharePoint Data to MySQL
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Microsoft SharePoint** as the data source.
2.  Select your added **MySQL** data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Microsoft SharePoint** account by providing your site name and then logging into your account, similar to the process described in this [Documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/sharepoint/setup.html) page.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/sharepoint/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
